name: P-School 画像モデルお試し：主人公・敵・背景を各モデルで1枚ずつ
style: Art style: match the reference images. Hand-painted 2D fantasy adventure game art with soft painterly shading, clean edges, warm natural light from the upper left, rich but natural colours and anime-influenced proportions. Not pixel art. No text, logo, watermark, signature, frame or border.

sprite.rules: One character only, full body from head to feet, turned three-quarters in a side view, seen from eye level, standing on an invisible ground line near the bottom edge with a small margin around the figure.
sprite.transparent: Transparent background: no scenery, no ground and no cast shadow.
sprite.flat: Plain flat pure white background (#FFFFFF): no scenery, no ground, no shadow and no gradient.

background: Wide battle background for a side-view game, seen from eye level. A flat walkable ground area fills the lower third across the whole width, where the hero stands on the left and an enemy on the right; keep the left and right middle areas free of large objects. No characters, creatures or people, and no UI.

jobs.title: 主人公（戦闘の構え・右向き）
jobs.prompt: The young explorer from the reference image, with the same face, aviator goggles on a safari hat, khaki shirt and shorts, large backpack with a bedroll, wooden staff and orange boots, in the same colours. A battle-ready stance holding the staff with both hands, facing RIGHT.

jobs.title: ステージ2の敵：ケミカルゴリラ（左向き）
jobs.prompt: A game enemy: a hulking gorilla mutated by chemicals that escaped from a laboratory, with glowing green slime on its fur and glass vials and tubes strapped to its body. Menacing but not gory, with a clear silhouette. Facing LEFT, toward the hero. Use the reference images for the art style only; do not draw the characters in them.

jobs.title: ステージ2の背景：荒れた研究所
jobs.prompt: An abandoned, overgrown laboratory: rows of large glass tanks of glowing green liquid along the back wall, old computers and tangled cables, and a cracked tiled floor with moss, lit by dim fluorescent light mixed with a green glow. Use the reference image for the art style and rendering only; do not copy its content.
